2 versatile.bio: 2 Versatile is a Canadian old-school hip-hop act whose self-titled album appeared in 1994. The group is part of the early Canadian rap catalogue and is associated with recordings including Cuddle with Me, which features Canadian R&B singer Glenn Lewis. Northern Dial carries 2 Versatile as part of that 1990s Canadian hip-hop lineage.

astrokidjay.bio: Astrokidjay is a Tanzania-born, Brampton-based rapper and singer whose melodic sound moves between hip-hop, R&B, trap and Afrobeats. His 2019 single Ibiza helped break him out of the local scene, and he has since become a recognizable voice in the Greater Toronto Area's new generation of rap artists. Northern Dial carries his music as part of its contemporary Canadian hip-hop catalogue.

big lysh.bio: Big Lysh is a Toronto hip-hop artist whose independent catalogue includes tracks such as Turks, 5am In Houston and Count That Cash. Her music sits within Toronto's contemporary rap scene, with releases and visuals distributed across major streaming and social platforms. Northern Dial carries Big Lysh as part of its ongoing coverage of emerging Canadian hip-hop.

bijaan.bio: Bijaan is a Calgary-born and based MC whose music blends old-school hip-hop foundations with a global perspective shaped by family roots in East Africa and India. He has performed at events including NXNE, Sled Island and JUNO Week, and his work has earned attention as part of a rising generation of Canadian hip-hop. Northern Dial carries Bijaan as part of its Western Canadian rap catalogue.

aiza.bio: Aiza is a Montreal-born, Toronto-based bilingual singer and songwriter whose music blends Afropop, R&B and pop. Born to Burundian immigrant parents, she has built a multidisciplinary career across music and screen work, while releases including her album Sovereignty have established her as a distinctive Canadian independent artist. Northern Dial carries Aiza as part of its contemporary Canadian R&B and pop catalogue.
